record.title: Reports generated together are listed in a different order every day
record.mechanical_flags: Recorded state has 0 comments; termination alone does not establish completion.
record.actual_decision: The agent read issue #4626 and searched the repository for report ordering and dashboard-related code. It inspected `src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts` and `src/report.tsx`, then searched for their usage. Although the reporter clarified that the problem concerned the dashboard's recent-reports list rather than the saved-reports API, the agent did not complete the triage or propose a solution. The run ended after reaching its four-model-call limit, with no comments, labels, PRs, or code changes.
record.observation: The agent correctly read issue #4626 and investigated report ordering using seven read-only tool calls. The issue discussion clarified that the problem was in the dashboard's recent-reports list, not the paginated saved-reports list. The source shows that `reportRepo.list()` orders reports by creation time and id, while `src/report.tsx` renders individual dashboard report entries. However, the agent reached its model-call limit without applying a label, posting a comment, or opening a PR. The recorded end state confirms no changes. I consider the run unsuccessful because it stopped before completing the legitimate feature triage.
record.confirmation: Explicit human confirmation in review workflow
